# Google Patents Inventor, Assignee & Citation Lookup

Pull complete patent records straight from Google's aggregated patent index — covering USPTO, EPO, WIPO, JPO, CNIPA, KIPO, and dozens of other offices — by free-text query, inventor, assignee, classification code, citation graph, publication number, or a pasted `patents.google.com` URL.

## What this actor does

- Searches the full Google Patents corpus by keyword, inventor name, assignee/company, or CPC/IPC classification code, or fetches one or more specific patents by publication number or URL.
- Walks a patent's citation graph one hop at a time — backward (what it cites), forward (what cites it), or both.
- Pulls full claims, abstract, description text, and classification codes when `fetchFullDetails` is enabled, rather than just the search snippet.
- Filters any mode by jurisdiction, legal status, filing/publication date range, and sorts by relevance, newest, or oldest.
- Fields Google Patents doesn't expose for a given patent (such as `grantDate` on a pending application) are left out of that record.

## Output per patent

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `publicationNumber`, `country` | Canonical publication number and filing-jurisdiction prefix |
| `title`, `snippet`, `abstract` | Patent title, search snippet, and full abstract |
| `description` | Specification text (truncated at 50,000 characters) |
| `claims`, `claimCount` | Each claim as its own string, and the total count |
| `inventors`, `primaryInventor` | All listed inventors, and the first-listed one |
| `assigneesOriginal`, `assigneesCurrent`, `primaryAssignee` | Assignees at filing, current assignees after reassignment, and the first one |
| `priorityDate`, `filingDate`, `publicationDate`, `grantDate`, `expirationDate` | Key dates in the patent's lifecycle |
| `applicationNumber` | The application's own filing number |
| `legalStatus` | Active / Expired / Pending, when shown |
| `classifications` | CPC and IPC codes |
| `backwardCitations`, `backwardCitationCount` | Patents this one cites, with publication number, title, dates, assignee |
| `forwardCitations`, `forwardCitationCount` | Patents that cite this one |
| `familyJurisdictions` | Per-country status of patent family members |
| `language` | Rendered-metadata locale |
| `pdfUrl`, `thumbnailUrl`, `figureUrls` | PDF link, front-page figure, and all embedded figures (search modes) |
| `patentUrl` | Canonical `patents.google.com` URL |
| `recordType` | `patent` or `citation` |
| `siteName` | Always `Google Patents` |
| `scrapedAt` | ISO 8601 timestamp of when the record was scraped |

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `searchPatents` | `searchPatents`, `byPatent`, `byInventor`, `byAssignee`, `byClassification`, `byCitation`, or `byUrl` |
| `query` | string | `quantum computing` | Free-text query (mode=`searchPatents`) |
| `publicationNumber` | string | – | Single publication number (mode=`byPatent`, `byCitation`) |
| `publicationNumbers` | array | `[]` | Multiple publication numbers to fetch or seed citations from |
| `inventor` | string | – | Inventor name (mode=`byInventor`) |
| `assignee` | string | – | Assignee/company name (mode=`byAssignee`) |
| `classification` | string | – | CPC/IPC code, e.g. `H04L9/06` (mode=`byClassification`) |
| `citationDirection` | string | `both` | `backward`, `forward`, or `both` (mode=`byCitation`) |
| `urls` | array | `[]` | Direct `patents.google.com` URLs (mode=`byUrl`) |
| `country` | string | – (any) | Restrict to a specific patent office |
| `language` | string | `en` | Translation locale for rendered metadata |
| `status` | string | – (any) | `GRANT` or `APPLICATION` |
| `sortBy` | string | `relevance` | `relevance`, `new`, or `old` |
| `filingDateFrom` | string | – | Drop patents filed before this date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) |
| `filingDateTo` | string | – | Drop patents filed after this date |
| `publicationDateFrom` | string | – | Drop patents published before this date |
| `publicationDateTo` | string | – | Drop patents published after this date |
| `fetchFullDetails` | boolean | `false` | For search modes, also fetch each patent's full page for claims/abstract/citations |
| `maxItems` | integer | `25` | Hard cap on emitted records (1–1000) |
| `useProxy` | boolean | `false` | Route requests through Apify proxy |
| `autoEscalateOnBlock` | boolean | `true` | Automatically retry through proxy if direct access is blocked |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object | AUTO | Apify proxy configuration, used when `useProxy` or auto-escalation triggers |

### Example: keyword search with full claims and abstracts

```json
{
  "mode": "searchPatents",
  "query": "solid-state battery",
  "fetchFullDetails": true,
  "maxItems": 20
}
```

### Example: assignee portfolio within a jurisdiction and date range

```json
{
  "mode": "byAssignee",
  "assignee": "IBM",
  "country": "US",
  "filingDateFrom": "2020-01-01",
  "maxItems": 50
}
```

### Example: citation graph for a specific patent

```json
{
  "mode": "byCitation",
  "publicationNumber": "US11704715B2",
  "citationDirection": "both"
}
```

## Use cases

- **Prior-art search** — find existing patents in a technology area before filing
- **IP landscaping** — map a classification code or technology space across assignees
- **Competitive intelligence** — pull a competitor's full patent portfolio by assignee name
- **Citation analysis** — trace which patents a key invention builds on, or who later cites it
- **Freedom-to-operate checks** — review legal status and expiration dates for patents in a space

## FAQ

**Does this scrape USPTO, EPO, or WIPO directly?**
No — it reads Google Patents, which already aggregates USPTO, EPO, WIPO, JPO, CNIPA, KIPO, and dozens of other offices into one searchable index, so a single run can span jurisdictions.

**How many patents can I get in one run?**
Up to `maxItems`, capped at 1000. For larger pulls, split the query across date ranges or jurisdictions and run multiple times.

**Does `fetchFullDetails` slow the run down?**
Yes — it adds a full page fetch per patent to retrieve claims, abstract, and citations. Leave it off if the search snippet (title, dates, primary inventor/assignee, thumbnail) is enough.

**Are the PDF links usable directly?**
Yes — `pdfUrl` points to a public Google Cloud Storage object with no authentication or hotlink restriction.

**Is citation traversal recursive?**
No, it's a single hop: `byCitation` returns the direct citations of the publication number(s) you supply. To go further, feed the returned publication numbers back in as a new run.

**Why did my non-English search return English metadata?**
Google Patents infers query language automatically; set `language` to bias the rendered metadata to a different locale.

**Do I need a login or API key?**
No — every mode reads Google Patents' public pages.

**Is this affiliated with Google or Google Patents?**
No. This is an independent, third-party actor that reads Google Patents' public data and is not operated by or affiliated with Google.
